announcements.label: Men's Conference
announcements.title: The Mandate of a Kingdom Man
announcements.detail: The 2nd Annual National Men's Conference, on Romans 12:11, with Pastor Sam Adusi and Pastor Adeyemi Sofolahan. Saturday, September 12, 2026 from 1:00pm to 4:00pm EST, on Zoom. Meeting ID 697 148 1978.

announcements.label: Our Year of Good Success
announcements.title: Our Year of Good Success
announcements.detail: The anchor for the year: the Lord will perfect that which concerns me; your mercy, O Lord, endures forever; do not forsake the works of your hands.

upcomingEvents.title: Night of worship
upcomingEvents.note: Every Friday to December 25, in place of the Friday prayer meeting

groups.name: Pastor Sam Adusi
groups.alt: Pastor Sam Adusi outdoors in a dark suit and red tie
groups.description: Pastor Samuel Adusi leads Gofamint Toronto and preaches on Sunday mornings. If you are visiting for the first time, or you would like someone to pray with you, ask for him.

groups.name: Pastor Jeff Ogboe
groups.alt: Pastor Jeff Ogboe in a grey suit and a striped tie
groups.description: Pastor Jeffery Ogboe is the assistant pastor at Gofamint Toronto, serving alongside Pastor Sam in the teaching and the care of the church. If you would like someone to pray with you, he is as good a person to ask.

groups.alt: The choir gathered outside the church in blue
groups.description: The choir leads the singing on a Sunday morning, and at the conventions and conferences the church takes part in through the year. If you sing or play, say so after a service, and there is room.

groups.name: Pastor Israel Sofolahan
groups.alt: Pastor Israel Sofolahan in a navy suit and gold tie
groups.description: The men meet to pray for one another and to talk plainly about work, marriage and fatherhood. Their largest gathering of the year is the National Men's Conference.

groups.name: Deaconess Grace Adusi
groups.alt: Deaconess Grace Adusi in a red hat and a red floral dress
groups.description: The women pray for the church and look after the people in it, from the mother with a newborn to the sister who arrived in Toronto last month. Whatever season you are in, you are welcome.

groups.name: Sister Ebunoluwa
groups.alt: Sister Ebunoluwa in a white shirt, outdoors on a bright day
groups.description: Students and young adults, meeting to study together and to work out what following Christ looks like in a classroom and a first job. Some of it happens on Zoom, so distance is no reason to stay away.

groups.name: Ms. Obadaki
groups.alt: Ms. Obadaki in a grey blazer at the Gofamint Canada convention
groups.description: The children are taught on a Sunday in a way that is theirs, rather than a shortened version of what the adults are given. Bring them. They are expected, not merely tolerated.
